race.comment: JUST HEAR ME OUT (7) looked smart at Wagga first up, then came to town with a fading on pace ninth over 1200m at Rosehill in this grade. Strips fitter third up and look for a better showing over this trip. Solid each way player. PARTY BOSS (2) consistent gelding racing in career best form. Came to town third up with a sound second to Bluish Hue over 1400m at Randwick in this class. Will sit just off the speed and pounce late. LE CHOCOLAT (5) total forgive from the wide gate second up with a game seventh over 1200m at Rosehill. Ready for the trip and this combination have an excellent record in this grade. MISS FENNELL (13) closed strongly first up from the outside gate to secure sixth over 1200m at Canberra. Proven in this company and gets in light with the 6kg weight drop. BONNIE MURRINGO (14) near her top now third up and like the way she closed off in this company at Randwick. Worth thought. The chances don't end there.
